title: Family Night: Paint Your Own Pottery Drop-In
venue: A2AC (Ann Arbor Art Center), 117 W Liberty, Ann Arbor, MI
description: @ Add to calendar Google Calendar iCalendar Outlook 365 Outlook Live Deck the halls with something handmade! Come get into the holiday spirit and paint your very own winter-themed ceramic project. Choose from a variety of festive shapes and use colorful underglazes to create a personalized keepsake. Hang it on your tree, gift it to someone special, or keep it as a holiday treasure for years to come! Participants can join in at any time during this unique drop-in session, and paint one object. Some things to note: This workshop is suitable for students of all skill levels. The classroom may feature bright, overhead lighting, and music may be played throughout class. All children must be at least 5 years old and must accompanied by an adult. Please note: the A2AC does not make exceptions to the age minimum for any reason. Price is per person. Please register each individual child and adult that will be making a project. Adults that are not making a project do not need to register and may accompany and assist their child/children. All projects will be coated in a clear, food-safe glaze. It is likely, but not guaranteed that these projects will be processed, fired in the kiln, and ready for pick-up before December 25th. Participants will receive an e-mail notification when projects are ready for pick-up.
